newsitem.title: JAPAN: Airbus says to launch A3XX in Dec 1998.
newsitem.headline: Airbus says to launch A3XX in Dec 1998.

text.p: Airbus Industrie plans to launch its first A3XX large passenger aircraft in December 1998, the consortium's senior vice president John Leahy told a new conference in Tokyo on Tuesday.
"The A3XX will be the flagship of the 21st century," Leahy said.
He said Airbus was seeking partners, including Japanese companies, to bear 40 percent of the $8 billion development costs for the 555-seat passenger plane.
Leahy declined to say which companies might join the venture.
He said Airbus aimed to launch the new airliner in December 1998.
He also said that the company expects to win more than half of the total global airliner market by around 2002.
"Shortly after the turn of the century we will pass the 50 percent market share point."
